title: Don Phillips: humans have the fastest computer
summary: Don Phillips tells of Don Phillips: humans have the fastest computer, about unspecified at Lockheed Skunk Works, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Humanity has the quickest uh computer built into them than any man-made computer can ever approach.

plain: Don Phillips, a man connected to Lockheed's Skunk Works, the aircraft maker's secret advanced design division, said on Jesse Michels's podcast that people carry a faster computer inside them than any machine humans could ever build. In his view the human mind is more powerful than any technology we can make.
